bug_semantics: SiYuan database (attribute-view) view, field-edit, and group menus interpolate stored metadata into HTML that is parsed via insertAdjacentHTML/innerHTML. In getViewHTML and getEditHTML, view.desc/colData.desc are passed through escapeAttr for the textarea data-value attribute on the same line and left raw in the element body, so a stored value such as closes the textarea and runs an event-handler. Group menus interpolate item.name and column.name into b3-menu__label / b3-menu__accelerator spans without escapeHtml; one group-name source is the kernel empty-group label that interpolates a raw field name into language string 264 ('Field [%s] is empty'). On the desktop client, Electron windows set nodeIntegration:true and contextIsolation:false, so the stored XSS reaches Node builtins.
flaw_origin: The smallest first-write of the advisory's distinctive sink (escaped attribute plus unescaped textarea body assigned as HTML) is e9c8cd0e0d3bd0ff72ddb4c416c811d1949b8a19 (2024-11-18, Vanessa, issue 11053). That commit converted the parent input-attribute interpolation of view.desc into <textarea data-value="${escapeAttr(view.desc)}">${view.desc}</textarea> in getViewHTML and added the same escapeAttr-vs-raw-body pattern for column-header oldDesc in col.ts. Immediate parent 81ef5d0244d272bca2bfe77f4eea10e7c7b01f72 still has <input value="${view.desc}" data-value="${view.desc}"> and no textarea-body interpolation. Same-day follow-up cce77eb712796f4deec631b62553f43aba1ac238 copied the pattern into getEditHTML (colData.desc). Later 2025 work added the groups.ts name interpolations that the same lock commit also escaped. e9c8cd0e0 is a single-parent non-squash commit; the lock fix wraps the listed interpolations in escapeHtml.
